1.name: Fighting Style
1.notes:
You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. Defense is recommended.
Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

1.name: Second Wind
1.notes:
As a Bonus Action, you can regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Fighter level.
You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
You gain additional uses at higher levels as shown in the class table.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.notes:
You can use the mastery properties of three Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Each Long Rest, you may change one weapon choice.
You gain access to additional mastery options as you gain Fighter levels.

2.name: Action Surge
2.notes:
On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the Magic action.
Once used, you must finish a Short or Long Rest before using it again.
At level 17, you can use this feature twice between rests but only once per turn.

2.name: Tactical Mind
2.notes: When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of Second Wind to add 1d10 to the result instead of regaining Hit Points. If the check still fails, the use of Second Wind is not expended.

3.name: Subclass Feature
3.notes: You gain a Fighter subclass of your choice and its level 3 feature.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.notes: You gain an Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.notes: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.

5.name: Tactical Shift
5.notes: When you activate Second Wind, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

6.name: Ability Score Improvement
6.notes: You gain an Ability Score Improvement feat or another qualifying feat.

7.name: Subclass Feature
7.notes: You gain a level 7 feature from your Fighter subclass.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.notes: You gain an Ability Score Improvement feat or another qualifying feat.

9.name: Indomitable
9.notes:
When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it and add a bonus equal to your Fighter level. You must use the new roll.
You regain all uses after a Long Rest.
You gain additional uses at levels 13 and 17.

9.name: Tactical Master
9.notes: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you may replace its mastery property with Push, Sap, or Slow for that attack.

10.name: Subclass Feature
10.notes: You gain a level 10 feature from your Fighter subclass.

11.name: Two Extra Attacks
11.notes: You can attack three times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.notes: You gain an Ability Score Improvement feat or another qualifying feat.

13.name: Indomitable
13.notes: You now have two uses of Indomitable between Long Rests.

13.name: Studied Attacks
13.notes: If you miss an attack against a creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

14.name: Ability Score Improvement
14.notes: You gain an Ability Score Improvement feat or another qualifying feat.

15.name: Subclass Feature
15.notes: You gain a level 15 feature from your Fighter subclass.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.notes: You gain an Ability Score Improvement feat or another qualifying feat.

17.name: Action Surge
17.notes: You can now use Action Surge twice between rests, but only once per turn.

17.name: Indomitable
17.notes: You now have three uses of Indomitable between Long Rests.

18.name: Subclass Feature
18.notes: You gain a level 18 feature from your Fighter subclass.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.notes: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another qualifying feat. Boon of Combat Prowess is recommended.

20.name: Three Extra Attacks
20.notes: You can attack four times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.
